title: ARG Identity Lineage Schema
description: Tracks cryptographic parent-child execution ancestry across the full agent execution tree

lineage_id.description: Unique identifier for this execution lineage chain

root_human_principal.description: The human user who initiated the original request

principal_id.description: Unique identifier of the originating human principal

authorized_scope.description: Explicit list of actions the human principal authorized

execution_chain.description: Ordered chain of agent nodes in the execution tree

parent_node_id.description: Parent node ID. Null for root agent only.

agent_type.description: Type of agent at this node

scope_at_initialization.description: Exact scope and intent declared at the moment this node was initialized

purpose_classification.description: Purpose hash binding this node to its authorized intent

semantic_context_hash.description: Hash of the semantic context at initialization for drift detection

node_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this node including parent hash, creating an immutable chain
